$comment: EXP-1602: eUI Motion display lists, the contract every painter replays (apps/desktop/crates/eui-motion/src/display.rs; packed encoding = README.md › Packed frames). AUTO-GENERATED expected values: `UPDATE_MOTION_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p eui-motion --test frames` (inputs kept). Each case: `id`, `covers` (what it exercises), `lottie` (a small inline Lottie document; load it as UTF-8 JSON with the default limits), `frames`: per sampled composition frame `frame` (Motion.sample(frame)) the expected `list` and `packed`. `list` = the DisplayList as serde JSON: {width, height, ops}; every op is an object tagged by `op`: `layer` {blend, alpha, transform, clip, filters?} opens an isolated group composited on its `pop` with `alpha` and `blend`, clipped to `clip` (empty = unclipped); `clip` {transform, path} intersects the clip until its `pop`; `pop` closes the innermost layer or clip; `fill` {transform, rule: nonzero|evenodd, brush, path}; `stroke` {transform, style: {width, cap: butt|round|square, join: miter|round|bevel, miter, dashes? (omitted when solid), dash_offset}, brush, path}; `image` {transform, asset (index into the motion's image assets), alpha, width, height} draws the asset into the rect 0,0,width,height. `transform` = [a, b, c, d, e, f] (x' = a·x + c·y + e, y' = b·x + d·y + f), in composition units, never inherited: there is no ambient transform. `path` = verbs tagged by `v`: {v:m,x,y} | {v:l,x,y} | {v:c,x1,y1,x2,y2,x,y} | {v:z}. `brush` tagged by `kind`: solid {color} | linear {start, end, stops} | radial {center, focal, radius, stops}; colours are straight sRGB RGBA in 0..1, stops {offset, color}. `blend` (kebab-case): normal, multiply, screen, overlay, darken, lighten, color-dodge, color-burn, hard-light, soft-light, difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, luminosity, then the compositing operators dst-in, dst-out (alpha mattes, masks), luma-in, luma-out (luma mattes), xor (merge paths); `filters` (omitted when empty) tagged by `kind`: blur {sigma_x, sigma_y} | color-matrix {m[20]} | gradient-map {stops, amount} | drop-shadow {color, dx, dy, sigma}. `packed` = the same frame as the f32 stream [VERSION=2, width, height, op…] (README.md › Packed frames; layer = 1, blend code, alpha, t[6], clip path, filter count, filters; version 2 = round 8: adds the `text` op only a Canvas emits, fixtures/canvas.json; a Motion's frames are unchanged apart from the version word). Replays compare `list` structurally (same keys, same array lengths, same strings) and `packed` element by element; numbers match within 1e-4 × max(1, |expected|).

cases.covers: clip (layer bounds) + fill + pop; solid brush; rect path (M L L L Z)
rounded rect and ellipse as cubics (C); one fill applied to two shapes
bezier path (sh), two subpaths, fill rule evenodd (r 2)
star (sy 1) and polygon (sy 2) with roundness
stroke: width, round cap/join (lc 2, lj 2), miter join with limit (lj 1), bevel (lj 3), square cap (lc 3)
dashes (d: d/g/o) with an animated offset
gradient fill (gf t 1): linear brush, colour stops + opacity stops
radial gradient (gf t 2) with highlight length/angle (focal point), gradient stroke (gs)
animated position, scale, rotation, anchor and opacity with easing; hold keyframe (h 1)
split position (p.s with x/y), skew + skew axis
nested groups with their own transforms and opacity; layer parenting through a null (ty 3)
layer op (isolated group): opacity < 100 and blend modes multiply (bm 1), difference (bm 10)
masks: add (a), subtract (s), intersect (i), inverted, mask opacity
alpha matte (td 1 + tt 1) and inverted alpha matte (tt 2)
luma matte (tt 3) and inverted luma matte (tt 4)
matte by reference (tp: the matte layer's ind, not adjacent)
precomp layer (ty 0): clipped to its w × h, start time offset (st), in/out points
time remap (tm, seconds) on a precomp
time stretch (sr 2) on a precomp
trim path (tm): start/end/offset, simultaneous (m 1)
trim path, individually (m 2) across two shapes
repeater (rp): 3 copies, offset, per-copy transform and start/end opacity
solid layer (ty 1, sc), image layer (ty 2 → image op, asset index into images())
skipped: hidden shape (hd), hidden layer, unknown layer type, unknown shape type, layer outside its in/out points; draw order (later layers first)
